title: Dieterich Buxtehude: Fugue in C major, BuxWV 174
procedures: a voice held back until after the exposition

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 23–31). Returns in Episode 5 (bars 41–50).
sections.leads: From G major to C major

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject. Returns in Episode 4 (bars 35–37).
sections.leads: Between two statements in C major

sections.label: Answer in C major (Bass, its first entry)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 11–13), with the soprano's line in the tenor, the tenor's line in the bass, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject (3 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C major

sections.label: Subject in C major (Alto, its first entry)
Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 17–19), with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the alto, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C major

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 11–13) in part, with the soprano's line in the alto, at the same pitch level. Soprano: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C major; perfect cadence in C major at bar 50
